archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS INDUSTRIAL PRECISION

core_principles: Tactical Manufacturing Precision: Data-dense, high-scanability UI tailored for commercial printing management and machine operators.
Dual Theme Adaptability: Default light crisp industrial theme with rich slate neutrals, paired with a dark high-contrast tactical dark theme.
Redundant Status Encoding: Statuses must use explicit label text, distinct icons, and calibrated semantic badge colors (never relying solely on color).
Asymmetric Dashboard & Density Grid: Clear visual hierarchy separating high-level KPI stat cards, real-time Production Queue tables, System Edge Agents, and quick action cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a feature-complete, interactive SaaS dashboard following this exact layout and visual design system.
Implement Lucide React icons for all sidebar navigation links, status indicators, and action triggers.
Include a global state / mock dataset for real-time order status updates, filterable tabs, modal dialogs for recipe import and new order creation.
Ensure full support for dark and light theme switching with seamless Tailwind classes.
Provide clear data-testid attributes on all interactive elements across every tab, table row, and modal button.
